app.title: Elena — Road to the BFA
app.tagline: Every deadline, audition, and requirement in one place.

nyc.label: New York City area
nyc.note: Four schools audition in/around NYC (Jan-Mar). One or two well-timed trips can cover several. Purchase is Westchester, ~35 min from Grand Central.

socal.label: Southern California
socal.note: USC (LA), LMU (Westchester, ~12 mi from USC) and Chapman (Orange, ~40 mi) are combinable into one Southern California trip. LMU's audition is video-only, so it needs no travel of its own.

boston.label: Boston
boston.note: Boston Conservatory offers a live-online audition — may avoid the flight.

tucson.label: Tucson, AZ
tucson.note: Video-only audition accepted, but an in-person Sept/Jan date (before ~Feb 1) preserves first-year Dance Merit talent aid.

lastRefresh.summary: Re-verified all 9 schools against live sources. Two confirmed_2027 conflicts surfaced as pendingChange rather than overwritten: Fordham/Ailey's shared Nov 1 deadline split into Ailey Nov 6 / Fordham Common App Nov 8, and Pace's Sands pre-screen deadline moved from Jan 3 to Jan 4, 2027. LMU's FAFSA priority deadline was upgraded to confirmed_2027 (now explicitly tied to "Fall 2027 entry") and its audition portal description updated to name Slate explicitly. Boston Conservatory's Regular Action decision-release date was corrected (Apr 1 → Mar 31, not a confirmed fact). NYU Tisch, SUNY Purchase, USC Kaufman, Chapman, and Arizona's previously confirmed deadlines, fees, and audition dates all reconfirmed unchanged. Fordham's general fordham.edu pages remain bot-blocked (CAS login gateway).
